premises.text: Enterprises need massive-scale hyper-fast SQL joins that conventional databases cannot deliver in practical time
premises.evidence_span: enterprises who need massive scale and hyper-fast SQL

premises.text: BlazingDB is a GPU-based distributed SQL engine that turns tables into matrices and parallelizes queries across thousands of GPU cores
premises.evidence_span: a next-generation SQL database on video graphics cards, or GPUs

premises.text: The system is fully distributed, self-configuring across cluster hardware/data/usage, and accessible via SQL interfaces and workbench
premises.evidence_span: It is a fully distributed technology that splits the data and the computation across multiple servers

premises.text: Offering includes cloud or on-prem deployment plus a free-for-life community edition for appropriately configured machines
premises.evidence_span: we're launching a community edition version of a GPU SQL database that is free to use for life

value.text: Massively faster SQL analytics for big enterprise datasets
value.evidence_span: That 35-hour monstrosity came down to 30 seconds

causal_links.evidence_span: it was taking our enterprise database server 35 hours to run
BlazingDB unlocks that power for enterprises who need massive scale and hyper-fast SQL
You can deploy it onto the cloud or an appropriately configured on-premise rig

notes: Benchmark multiples vs Redshift/Postgres/MySQL treated as performance package of the GPU SQL engine (§4.1.8), not separate premises. SQL market-size framing and pilot/customer traction excluded as market context/traction. Anti-template: need, engine, and distribution/edition GTM are separately revisable.
